verification.method: scripts/verify/time-cities.py recomputes every UTC offset, clock change and historical offset claim with Python zoneinfo (system IANA tz 2026e, independent of the browser/Node ICU copy) and every sunrise, sunset and solar noon with the astral library; coordinates read from the Wikipedia infobox
verification.what: UTC offsets, zone names, clock-change dates and times 2026-2027, historical offset claims in the text, sun table, time-difference table, title, description and JSON-LD
verification.against: IANA tz database 2026e; astral (NOAA equations); Wikipedia infobox coordinates
verification.result: All automated comparisons matched; sun times within 1.3 minutes of astral (rounding)
